office: any passport authority in Austria (district authority or magistrate); abroad, the embassy or consulate of the place of residence, or some honorary consulates

routes.label: at any passport authority in Austria
at an Austrian embassy or consulate
at an honorary consulate that takes applications, for 30 euros more

note: The card costs 91 euros from the 16th birthday, 39 euros from the 2nd, and nothing for a first card up to the 2nd birthday (a further one then costs 39 euros, not modelled), at home or at an embassy or consulate; an honorary consulate that takes the application charges 30 euros more, summed here. It is valid two years under 2, five years from 2, ten years from 12. A first card issued on the 2nd birthday itself is free and valid five years, which whole years of age can't tell apart. No processing time is published.
